---
title: Unknown state token
format:
  typst: default
filters:
  - veil
extensions:
  veil:
    state: "Bad!"
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        warnings: exhaustive
    typst:
      noErrors: true
      printsMessage:
        - level: WARN
          regex: "The option state has the token 'Bad!'"
          count: 1
---

Content.
